alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued October 9 at 8:27PM PDT until October 11 at 3:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning through Sunday afternoon,
significant coastal flooding and erosion possible. For the Beach
Hazards Statement from Sunday morning until Sunday evening, surf
of 5 to 7 feet with local sets up to 9 feet. For the Coastal
Flood Advisory from Sunday afternoon until Tuesday afternoon,
minor coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.
